messages.text: Hammer Miner Thor P2 does it only do solo mining

No, it does both. Point it at a pool and it stacks small steady payouts, or run it solo for the full block shot — you choose in the miner's settings.

At 166 W it's about $12 a month at 10¢. What's power cost where you'd run it?
what is the estimated earning from pool mining

At 10 TH/s the pool payout is a small steady trickle — at home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity; that's not why people buy it. You're buying the block shot that redraws every ten minutes for years, plus a real node-level look at how mining works.

If you want more hashrate per dollar, the Magic Miner 40T you were looking at is four times the hashrate for $799. Want me to run both side by side at your actual power rate?

That changes it — with solar your power cost is basically nothing, so whatever it mines is upside and the block shot runs for free.

It also means hashrate is what matters, not watts. The Magic Miner 40T gives you four times the Thor P2's hashrate for $799 and ships Nov 21, 2026. How much surplus solar do you have to spare?
can solo and pool mining be used on this device

Yes — both, on either unit. You point it at a pool address for steady payouts, or a solo pool like ckpool for the full block shot. It's one setting in the miner's web interface, and you can switch any time, as often as you like.

One machine can only do one at a time, though.
do you have a machine that can do both

No miner splits itself between two pools at once — that's just how the protocol works. The way people get both is two machines: one on a pool stacking sats, one pointed at solo.

With solar, a Thor P2 at $369 solo plus the Magic Miner 40T at $799 on a pool covers both. Want me to price that pair?
